name: exposed_record
description: In `discontinue_product`, the write endpoint updates `Product.p_status` to `"discontinued"`, but `get_product_availability` reads from `Product` using only `Product.p_productkey == p_productkey` and does not filter out discontinued records. This matches the exposed-record signal because a lifecycle status change is written, yet the read endpoint continues returning the product as purchasable/available.
